learningObjective: Identify which tensor values share one mean and variance in CNN BatchNorm versus transformer LayerNorm.
mediumRationale: Responsive semantic grids make shared statistic groups spatially explicit and can stack on phones. Mermaid cannot represent normalization axes precisely, and interaction does not improve the core grouping lesson.

pages.insight: The source slide highlights different tensor slices for BatchNorm, LayerNorm, InstanceNorm, and GroupNorm, making axis choice the central visual idea.

deckReview.notes: The implementation preserves the slide's strongest insight, colored statistic groups, but redraws only CNN BatchNorm and transformer LayerNorm to avoid a dense all-method comparison.
